title: mri_seg_overlap
description: Compute the structural overlap between two segmentation volumes.

out_file.description: Save detailed overlap report to a JSON file.
out_file.title: Output file

measures.description: List of measures to compute. Options include: dice, jaccard, voldiff.
measures.title: Measures

labels.description: Space-separated list of label values to include.
labels.title: Labels

label_names.description: Custom label names corresponding to the values specified with the --labels flag.
label_names.title: Label names

label_file.description: Text file specifying the label values to include. Must be in the format of a freesurfer lookup-table.
label_file.title: Label file

seg_flag.description: Compute overlap between the major segmentation structures.
seg_flag.title: Segmentation flag

quiet_flag.description: Quiet mode - do not print results to stdout.
quiet_flag.title: Quiet flag
